profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Thanks for stopping by my profile! I'm a frontend engineer with a passion for crafting fast, reliable, and user-friendly web applications. Over the past few years, I've had the chance to work on exciting products in the online gaming space, building sleek UIs, fine-tuning performance, and collaborating with talented teams across design, backend, and DevOps. Whether it's scaling systems, mentoring teammates, or diving into the details of a React component, I enjoy solving complex problems and making things better, bit by bit. If you're working on something interesting or just want to connect, I'd love to chat!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineer on the Casino Platform team 
- Specialized in frontend development with TypeScript and React
- Built backend microservices
  - Using C#/.NET with SQL
  - Using TypeScript with Node.js ORMs (TypeORM, Prisma)
- Monitored frontend and backend metrics and handled pager alerts as part of a monthly on-call rotation
